title: Route scalar callers through existing SIMD dispatch
description:
Quick wins where SIMD machinery already exists in `gf2-kernels-simd` or the dispatch layer but scalar callers bypass it. Each task in this story wires a caller through the appropriate dispatch path, records correctness/perf evidence, and leaves unsafe code isolated.

## Background

`gf2-core` had three dispatch-routing gaps: `BitMatrix::matvec` computed parity with scalar `count_ones() % 2` while popcount SIMD machinery existed; `BitMatrix::mul` did not route its non-M4RM row-XOR fallback through `xor_fn`; and `gfp::FieldVec` fell back to scalar element-wise loops for generic primes despite the `SimdVecOps` infrastructure.

This story has four completed child tasks:

- `c69d2055`: hoist XOR dispatch for M4RM row-XOR users.
- `8e4b189c`: route dense `BitMatrix::matvec` design sizes through fused AVX2 AND+popcount dispatch.
- `5223bb04`: route the non-M4RM `BitMatrix::mul` row-XOR fallback through existing `xor_fn` dispatch and gate it on a fallback-specific benchmark.
- `cad241e6`: add generic FieldVec SIMD dispatch for Montgomery-capable generic primes while preserving specialized M31 dispatch.

## Approved amendments / aggregate interpretation

A3 (`cad241e6`) was closed under a user-approved child-level performance amendment: the generic FieldVec route did not produce a standalone >=1.5x throughput win and near-M61 measurements were near-parity/regressive, so its `criterion-1.5x` gate was removed from the child issue. The accepted value for A3 was architectural coverage and dispatch correctness for generic Montgomery-capable primes, with specialized M31 SIMD dispatch preserved. This parent story inherits that already-approved exception; the story-level performance bar is therefore evaluated per child after child-level approved amendments, not as a literal unamended >=1.5x requirement for A3.

A1 and A2 retain explicit >=1.5x performance evidence:

- A1 (`8e4b189c`): 2.636x geomean on dense matvec design sizes after the approved fused AND+popcount amendment.
- A2 (`5223bb04`): 2.015x geomean on the dedicated non-M4RM row-XOR fallback leaf after the approved fallback-benchmark amendment.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Each child task ships per its final approved child-level contract, including recorded correctness evidence, asm/perf evidence where applicable, and successful lead-run gates.
- [hard] A1 and A2 dispatch-routing tasks meet their >=1.5x performance gates at their approved design shapes.
- [hard] A3 records the approved performance exception and preserves specialized M31 SIMD dispatch while adding generic Montgomery-capable dispatch coverage.
- [hard] No `unsafe` introduced outside `gf2-kernels-simd`.
- [hard] No unreviewed regression on the integrated fast-tier CI gate.

## Notes

Highest-ROI dispatch-routing story in the epic. Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
